title: psilanthus horsfieldianus
intro: Psilanthus horsfieldianus, commonly known as the Himalayan Boxwood, is a plant species in the family Ericaceae. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine, where it is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Psilanthus horsfieldianus may help to protect against chronic diseases, such as cancer and cardiovascular disease, and may also have a role in modulating the immune system.
